passages.text: In the twenty-third year of the reign of Joash son of Ahaziah over Judah, Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria seventeen years.
passages.sermon:
Joash was the son of Ahaziah.
Joash was king of Judah.
Joash had reigned for twenty-three years.
Jehoahaz was the son of Jehu.
Jehoahaz became king of Israel.
Jehoahaz began to reign in the twenty-third year of Joash’s reign.
Jehoahaz ruled in Samaria.
Jehoahaz reigned for seventeen years.
passages.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְשָׁלֹשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לְיוֹאָ֥שׁ בֶּן־ אֲחַזְיָ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ יְהוֹאָחָ֨ז בֶּן־ יֵה֤וּא עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן שְׁבַ֥ע עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and followed the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit; he did not turn away from them.
passages.sermon:
Jehoahaz was king of Israel.
He did evil in the sight of the LORD.
He followed the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat.
Jeroboam had caused Israel to sin.
Jehoahaz did not turn away from these sins.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ֠יֵּלֶךְ אַחַ֨ר חַטֹּ֜את יָרָבְעָ֧ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֛ט אֲשֶׁר־ הֶחֱטִ֥יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹא־ סָ֥ר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃

passages.text: So the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He delivered them continually into the hands of Hazael king of Aram and his son Ben-hadad.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD became very angry with Israel.
The LORD acted because of Israel’s evil.
The LORD gave Israel into the power of Hazael.
Hazael was the king of Aram.
The LORD also gave Israel into the power of Ben-hadad.
Ben-hadad was the son of Hazael.
This continued for many days.
passages.original: וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֞ם בְּיַ֣ד׀ חֲזָאֵ֣ל מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲרָ֗ם וּבְיַ֛ד בֶּן־ הֲדַ֥ד בֶּן־ חֲזָאֵ֖ל כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃

passages.text: Then Jehoahaz sought the favor of the LORD, and the LORD listened to him because He saw the oppression that the king of Aram had inflicted on Israel.
passages.sermon:
Jehoahaz was king of Israel.
Jehoahaz sought the favor of the LORD.
The LORD listened to Jehoahaz.
The LORD saw that Israel was suffering.
The king of Aram oppressed Israel.
The LORD saw this oppression.
passages.original: וַיְחַ֥ל יְהוֹאָחָ֖ז אֶת־ פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע אֵלָיו֙ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֤י רָאָה֙ אֶת־ לַ֣חַץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּֽי־ לָחַ֥ץ אֹתָ֖ם מֶ֥לֶךְ אֲרָֽם׃

passages.text: So the LORD gave Israel a deliverer, and they escaped the power of the Arameans. Then the people of Israel lived in their own homes as they had before.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD gave Israel a deliverer.
Israel escaped from the power of the Arameans.
The people of Israel lived in their own homes.
They lived as they had before.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֤ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מוֹשִׁ֔יעַ וַיֵּ֣צְא֔וּ מִתַּ֖חַת יַד־ אֲרָ֑ם וַיֵּשְׁב֧וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶ֖ם כִּתְמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם׃

passages.text: Nevertheless, they did not turn away from the sins that the house of Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit, but they continued to walk in them. The Asherah pole even remained standing in Samaria.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel did not turn away from their sins.
The house of Jeroboam had led Israel into these sins.
The people continued to follow these sinful ways.
The Asherah pole still stood in Samaria.
passages.original: אַ֠ךְ לֹֽא־ סָ֜רוּ מֵחַטֹּ֧אות בֵּית־ יָרָבְעָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־ הֶחֱטִי אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּ֣הּ הָלָ֑ךְ וְגַם֙ הָאֲשֵׁרָ֔ה עָמְדָ֖ה בְּשֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃

passages.text: Jehoahaz had no army left, except fifty horsemen, ten chariots, and ten thousand foot soldiers, because the king of Aram had destroyed them and made them like the dust at threshing.
passages.sermon:
Jehoahaz was king of Israel.
He had almost no army left.
He had only fifty horsemen.
He had only ten chariots.
He had only ten thousand foot soldiers.
The king of Aram destroyed the rest of his army.
The king of Aram crushed them like dust at threshing.
passages.original: כִּ֣י לֹא֩ הִשְׁאִ֨יר לִיהוֹאָחָ֜ז עָ֗ם כִּ֣י אִם־ חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים פָּֽרָשִׁים֙ וַעֲשָׂ֣רָה רֶ֔כֶב וַעֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִ֖ים רַגְלִ֑י כִּ֤י אִבְּדָם֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם וַיְשִׂמֵ֥ם כֶּֽעָפָ֖ר לָדֻֽשׁ׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, along with all his accomplishments and his might, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
passages.sermon:
Jehoahaz was a king of Israel.
He did many things during his reign.
He showed strength and might.
The rest of the acts of Jehoahaz are recorded.
They are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
passages.original: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֧י יְהוֹאָחָ֛ז וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה וּגְבוּרָת֑וֹ הֲלוֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And Jehoahaz rested with his fathers and was buried in Samaria. And his son Jehoash reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Jehoahaz was king of Israel.
Jehoahaz died.
People buried Jehoahaz in Samaria.
Jehoash was the son of Jehoahaz.
Jehoash became king after Jehoahaz.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יְהֽוֹאָחָז֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַֽיִּקְבְּרֻ֖הוּ בְּשֹׁמְר֑וֹן וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יוֹאָ֥שׁ בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ

passages.text: In the thirty-seventh year of the reign of Joash over Judah, Jehoash son of Jehoahaz became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned sixteen years.
passages.sermon:
Joash was king of Judah.
He had reigned for thirty-seven years.
At that time, Jehoash became king of Israel.
Jehoash was the son of Jehoahaz.
Jehoash ruled in Samaria.
He reigned over Israel for sixteen years.
passages.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וָשֶׁ֙בַע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לְיוֹאָ֖שׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ יְהוֹאָ֨שׁ בֶּן־ יְהוֹאָחָ֤ז עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן שֵׁ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and did not turn away from all the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit, but he walked in them.
passages.sermon:
Jehoash was king of Israel.
He did evil in the sight of the LORD.
He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat.
Jeroboam had caused Israel to sin.
Jehoash followed those same sins.
passages.original: וַיַּֽעֲשֶׂ֥ה הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מִכָּל־ חַטֹּ֞אות יָרָבְעָ֧ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֛ט אֲשֶׁר־ הֶחֱטִ֥יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּ֥הּ הָלָֽךְ׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Jehoash, along with all his accomplishments and his might, including his war against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
passages.sermon:
Jehoash was king of Israel.
He did many things during his reign.
He showed great strength.
He fought against Amaziah, who was king of Judah.
The rest of Jehoash’s deeds are recorded.
They are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
passages.original: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֤י יוֹאָשׁ֙ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וּגְב֣וּרָת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִלְחַ֔ם עִ֖ם אֲמַצְיָ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֑ה הֲלֽוֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And Jehoash rested with his fathers, and Jeroboam succeeded him on the throne. Jehoash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Jehoash was king of Israel.
Jehoash died.
Jehoash joined his ancestors in death.
Jeroboam became king after Jehoash.
People buried Jehoash in Samaria.
Jehoash was buried with the kings of Israel.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יוֹאָשׁ֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וְיָרָבְעָ֖ם יָשַׁ֣ב עַל־ כִּסְא֑וֹ וַיִּקָּבֵ֤ר יוֹאָשׁ֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן עִ֖ם מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

passages.text: When Elisha had fallen sick with the illness from which he would die, Jehoash king of Israel came down to him and wept over him, saying, “My father, my father, the chariots and horsemen of Israel!”
passages.sermon:
Elisha was a prophet in Israel.
Elisha became sick.
This sickness would cause Elisha to die.
Jehoash was the king of Israel.
Jehoash went down to visit Elisha.
Jehoash wept over Elisha’s face.
Jehoash said, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!”
passages.original: וֶֽאֱלִישָׁע֙ חָלָ֣ה אֶת־ חָלְי֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָמ֖וּת בּ֑וֹ וַיֵּ֨רֶד אֵלָ֜יו יוֹאָ֣שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַיֵּ֤בְךְּ עַל־ פָּנָיו֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר אָבִ֣י׀ אָבִ֔י רֶ֥כֶב יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּפָרָשָֽׁיו׃

passages.text: Elisha told him, “Take a bow and some arrows.” So Jehoash took a bow and some arrows.
passages.sermon:
Elisha was a prophet of God in Israel.
Jehoash was the king of Israel.
Elisha spoke to Jehoash.
Elisha said, “Take a bow and some arrows.”
Jehoash took a bow.
Jehoash took some arrows.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ אֱלִישָׁ֔ע קַ֖ח קֶ֣שֶׁת וְחִצִּ֑ים וַיִּקַּ֥ח אֵלָ֖יו קֶ֥שֶׁת וְחִצִּֽים׃

passages.text: Then Elisha said to the king of Israel, “Put your hand on the bow.” So the king put his hand on the bow, and Elisha put his hands on the king’s hands.
passages.sermon:
Elisha was a prophet of God.
The king of Israel was Jehoash.
Elisha spoke to Jehoash.
Elisha said, “Put your hand on the bow.”
Jehoash put his hand on the bow.
Elisha placed his hands on the king’s hands.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הַרְכֵּ֤ב יָֽדְךָ֙ עַל־ הַקֶּ֔שֶׁת וַיַּרְכֵּ֖ב יָד֑וֹ וַיָּ֧שֶׂם אֱלִישָׁ֛ע יָדָ֖יו עַל־ יְדֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: “Open the east window,” said Elisha. So he opened it and Elisha said, “Shoot!” So he shot. And Elisha declared: “This is the LORD’s arrow of victory, the arrow of victory over Aram, for you shall strike the Arameans in Aphek until you have put an end to them.”
passages.sermon:
Elisha was a prophet of God.
Elisha spoke to the king of Israel.
Elisha said, “Open the east window.”
The king opened the window.
Elisha said, “Shoot!”
The king shot an arrow.
Elisha declared, “This is the LORD’s arrow of victory.”
Elisha said, “This is the arrow of victory over Aram.”
Elisha said, “You will strike the Arameans in Aphek.”
Elisha said, “You will defeat them until you have put an end to them.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר פְּתַ֧ח הַחַלּ֛וֹן קֵ֖דְמָה וַיִּפְתָּ֑ח וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלִישָׁ֤ע יְרֵה֙ וַיּ֔וֹר וַיֹּ֗אמֶר חֵץ־ תְּשׁוּעָ֤ה לַֽיהוָה֙ וְחֵ֣ץ תְּשׁוּעָ֣ה בַֽאֲרָ֔ם וְהִכִּיתָ֧ אֶת־ אֲרָ֛ם בַּאֲפֵ֖ק עַד־ כַּלֵּֽה׃

passages.text: Then Elisha said, “Take the arrows!” So he took them, and Elisha said to the king of Israel, “Strike the ground!” So he struck the ground three times and stopped.
passages.sermon:
Elisha was a prophet of God.
The king of Israel stood before Elisha.
Elisha spoke to the king.
Elisha said, “Take the arrows.”
The king took the arrows.
Elisha spoke again to the king.
Elisha said, “Strike the ground.”
The king struck the ground three times.
The king stopped striking the ground.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֛אמֶר קַ֥ח הַחִצִּ֖ים וַיִּקָּ֑ח וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לְמֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הַךְ־ אַ֔רְצָה וַיַּ֥ךְ שָֽׁלֹשׁ־ פְּעָמִ֖ים וַֽיַּעֲמֹֽד׃

passages.text: But the man of God was angry with him and said, “You should have struck the ground five or six times. Then you would have struck down Aram until you had put an end to it. But now you will strike down Aram only three times.”
passages.sermon:
Elisha was a prophet and a man of God.
Elisha became angry with the king of Israel.
Elisha said, “You should have struck the ground five or six times.”
“If you had done this, you would have defeated Aram completely.”
“But now you will defeat Aram only three times.”
passages.original: וַיִּקְצֹ֨ף עָלָ֜יו אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לְהַכּ֨וֹת חָמֵ֤שׁ אוֹ־ שֵׁשׁ֙ פְּעָמִ֔ים אָ֛ז הִכִּ֥יתָ אֶת־ אֲרָ֖ם עַד־ כַּלֵּ֑ה וְעַתָּ֕ה שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים תַּכֶּ֥ה אֶת־ אֲרָֽם׃ס

passages.text: And Elisha died and was buried. Now the Moabite raiders used to come into the land every spring.
passages.sermon:
Elisha was a prophet in Israel.
Elisha died.
People buried Elisha.
Moabite raiders came into the land every spring.
passages.original: וַיָּ֥מָת אֱלִישָׁ֖ע וַֽיִּקְבְּרֻ֑הוּ וּגְדוּדֵ֥י מוֹאָ֛ב יָבֹ֥אוּ בָאָ֖רֶץ בָּ֥א שָׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: Once, as the Israelites were burying a man, suddenly they saw a band of raiders, so they threw the man’s body into Elisha’s tomb. And as soon as his body touched the bones of Elisha, the man was revived and stood up on his feet.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were burying a man.
They saw a band of raiders coming.
They quickly threw the man’s body into Elisha’s tomb.
Elisha was a prophet of God.
The dead man’s body touched Elisha’s bones.
The man came back to life.
He stood up on his feet.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֞י הֵ֣ם׀ קֹבְרִ֣ים אִ֗ישׁ וְהִנֵּה֙ רָא֣וּ אֶֽת־ הַגְּד֔וּד וַיַּשְׁלִ֥יכוּ אֶת־ הָאִ֖ישׁ בְּקֶ֣בֶר אֱלִישָׁ֑ע וַיֵּ֜לֶךְ וַיִּגַּ֤ע הָאִישׁ֙ בְּעַצְמ֣וֹת אֱלִישָׁ֔ע וַיְחִ֖י וַיָּ֥קָם עַל־ רַגְלָֽיו׃פ

passages.text: And Hazael king of Aram oppressed Israel throughout the reign of Jehoahaz.
passages.sermon: Hazael was the king of Aram.\r\nHazael oppressed Israel.\r\nHe did this during the entire reign of Jehoahaz.
passages.original: וַֽחֲזָאֵל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם לָחַ֖ץ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י יְהוֹאָחָֽז׃

passages.text: But the LORD was gracious to Israel and had compassion on them, and He turned toward them because of His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. And to this day, the LORD has been unwilling to destroy them or cast them from His presence.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD showed grace to Israel.
The LORD had compassion on Israel.
The LORD turned toward Israel.
The LORD did this because of His covenant.
The LORD made this covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
The LORD did not want to destroy Israel.
The LORD did not cast Israel away from His presence.
The LORD has not done this up to this day.
passages.original: וַיָּחָן֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֹתָ֤ם וַֽיְרַחֲמֵם֙ וַיִּ֣פֶן אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם לְמַ֣עַן בְּרִית֔וֹ אֶת־ אַבְרָהָ֖ם יִצְחָ֣ק וְיַֽעֲקֹ֑ב וְלֹ֤א אָבָה֙ הַשְׁחִיתָ֔ם וְלֹֽא־ הִשְׁלִיכָ֥ם מֵֽעַל־ פָּנָ֖יו עַד־ עָֽתָּה׃

passages.text: When Hazael king of Aram died, his son Ben-hadad reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Hazael was king of Aram.
Hazael died.
Ben-hadad was Hazael’s son.
Ben-hadad became king after Hazael died.
passages.original: וַיָּ֖מָת חֲזָאֵ֣ל מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲרָ֑ם וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ בֶּן־ הֲדַ֥ד בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

passages.text: Then Jehoash son of Jehoahaz took back from Ben-hadad son of Hazael the cities that Hazael had taken in battle from his father Jehoahaz. Jehoash defeated Ben-hadad three times, and so recovered the cities of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Jehoash was the son of Jehoahaz.
Ben-hadad was the son of Hazael.
Hazael had taken cities from Jehoahaz in battle.
Jehoash fought against Ben-hadad.
Jehoash defeated Ben-hadad three times.
Jehoash took back the cities from Ben-hadad.
Jehoash restored the cities of Israel.
passages.original: וַיָּ֜שָׁב יְהוֹאָ֣שׁ בֶּן־ יְהוֹאָחָ֗ז וַיִּקַּ֤ח אֶת־ הֶֽעָרִים֙ מִיַּד֙ בֶּן־ הֲדַ֣ד בֶּן־ חֲזָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָקַ֗ח מִיַּ֛ד יְהוֹאָחָ֥ז אָבִ֖יו בַּמִּלְחָמָ֑ה שָׁלֹ֤שׁ פְּעָמִים֙ הִכָּ֣הוּ יוֹאָ֔שׁ וַיָּ֖שֶׁב אֶת־ עָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
